$comment: Canonical metric vocabulary for compilation reports. Run scripts/gen-metric-names.mjs to regenerate typed constants.

source_surface_coverage.description: Fraction of source surface covered by collider hulls

worst_decile_surface_coverage.description: Coverage of the worst-performing 10% of surface area

collider_volume_precision.description: Fraction of collider volume that overlaps real source volume

false_fill_fraction.description: Fraction of collider volume that is empty (false positive)

deep_false_fill_fraction.description: Fraction of collider volume at significant depth that is empty

hull_count.description: Number of convex hulls in the collider

hull_vertex_count.description: Total number of vertices across collider hulls

hull_triangle_count.description: Total number of triangles across collider hulls

fallback_ratio.description: Fraction of collider hulls created as decomposition-failure fallbacks

planar_substitute_hulls.description: Number of intentional planar substitute hulls

snug_fit_status.description: Whether requested snug-fit refinement was applied, skipped, not requested, or unknown

probe_coverage.description: Fraction of downward artifact-probe rays that hit collider geometry

probe_gap_clusters.description: Number of spatially distinct gaps found by the artifact probe

sweep_traversability.description: Fraction of standable cells connected to the largest capsule-traversable island

standable_fraction.description: Fraction of grounded cells in which the configured capsule fits

clearance_blocked_fraction.description: Fraction of grounded cells displaced by insufficient capsule headroom

radius_blocked_fraction.description: Fraction of grounded cells rejected by lateral capsule contact

seam_snag_count.description: Number of deduplicated step-height discontinuities found by the capsule sweep

quality_surface_samples.description: Number of surface sample points used

quality_volume_samples.description: Number of volume sample points used
